_comment: Non-creature event cards. Effect types: gain_resource, lose_resource, light_delta, slow_next_turn, vp_delta. Events resolve immediately when drawn (see GDD 8.3).

events.name: Hidden Spring
events.desc: You find water no map remembers.

events.name: Sudden Storm
events.desc: The island reminds you who is bigger.

events.name: Spirit Whisper
events.desc: A voice on the wind approves of how you travel.

events.name: Old Shrine
events.desc: Someone tended this place once. You leave it better.

events.name: Rotten Cache
events.desc: Someone hoarded here. It did not end well.

events.name: Cold Mist
events.desc: You wander in circles until it lifts.

events.name: Echo of Greed
events.desc: You catch yourself wanting more than you need.
